However, the value of `unicodePath` itself (at line 9) is not affected by the value of `zipEntry.getName()` because `unicodePath` is determined by the `getExtraField()` call which happens before the ternary evaluation. The `zipEntry.getName()` is only used as a fallback value in the ternary expression, not as part of the computation that determines `unicodePath`.
